Description:
[center][color=#ffffff][size=5][font=Trebuchet MS]v1.1.0 Update[/font][/size][/color][/center]
[list]

[center][b][size=5][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#38761d]Installation & Usage[/color][/font][/size][/b][/center]
[list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/font][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/font][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].[/font][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]Run the game using SMAPI.[/font][/*]

[/list][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][b][color=#38761d]Compatibility[/color][/b][/size][/font]
